voiceBio:
I’m Rishi, a software engineer who likes building things that sit between software, AI, and infrastructure.

I build SaaS products, automation systems, AI applications, and developer tools. I’m especially interested in making complex systems simpler, cheaper, and more reliable.

This site is where I write about things I’m building, breaking, and learning along the way.
